facts: MotoPass has a 3-step registration flow: connect Nostr wallet → enter display name + target program → confirm and create profile.
Registration creates a UserProfile stored in localStorage with npub, pubkey, display name, target program, agent assignment (Kimi), and initial status 'registered'.
The profile status progresses through 8 stages: registered → documents → stamped → agent_assigned → submitted → payment_pending → in_review → approved.
ProgramsPage is the main discovery interface with 50 countries, offering table and card views with instant filtering.
Filter system supports: text search (name/details/bitcoin_integration), region, category, investment range ($0–$2M), crypto score (0–10), sovereignty (0–10), Lightning-only, and status.
Three filter presets are available: Under $100K investment, Lightning-ready only, Bitcoin-friendly (crypto score ≥7).
Gold Standard Spotlight highlights Uruguay and Bolivia as flagship depth programs that anchor research templates.
Program cards show: flag, country, status, proof badge, pathways count, flagship depth, sovereignty score, stacking synergy, risk level, Lightning readiness.
ProgramModal has 7 tabs: Overview, Pathways (flagships only), Finance, Bitcoin, Critical (flagships only), Legal, Intel, Paige, Sources.
The Intel tab displays sourced pros/cons with verification dates, scorecard bars, freshness status, and recent audit trail entries.
ProgramsComplianceStrip shows compliance metrics across all 50 jurisdictions.
The Apply page accepts: name, target program (free text), optional notes, and attachable stamped documents from the Vault.
Applications are SHA-256 hashed with the payload (program, created timestamp, npub, doc hashes) and stored locally with status 'interest'.
On successful application, the user is redirected to the Agents page with application parameters for agent handoff.
ApplyLaunchGatesDirectory shows 5 gates (Seal, Forge, Nexus, Ledger, Ops) that must pass before applications open.
The Stack Simulator (/simulator) lets users pick multiple programs and see combined metrics, synergy breakdown, and pathway-level capital analysis.
The Compare page (/compare) provides side-by-side matrix comparison of up to 4 programs with best-value badges.
The Portfolio page (/portfolio) is a saved list with Compliance Clock, reorder, and share functionality.
BTC Dual Price shows both USD and BTC equivalent at live rates throughout the interface.
URL state synchronization: filters, view mode, table density, and selected program are all encoded in search params for sharing.

The site uses 17 routes defined in App.tsx: /, /programs, /portfolio, /simulator, /compare, /btcmap, /vault, /distressed, /blog, /verify, /agents, /apply, /register, /dashboard, /profile, /blog/:slug, and a 404 catch-all.
I18n (internationalization) is built-in with translation keys for all UI strings, accessed via useI18n() hook and formatT() helper.
The pitch page (/) guides users through: overview with live stats → savings graphs → site guide (4 steps) → 4 pillars → products → how it works → FAQ → CTA.
The 4 guide steps are: 1) Explore programs at /programs, 2) Stamp documents at /vault, 3) Build your portfolio at /portfolio, 4) Apply at /apply.
New programs can be added via the Programs page '+' button — they are user-added stubs with 'Researching' status and default scores.
Programs can be exported as JSON (all or filtered) and imported back, supporting drag-and-drop and file picker.
Saved filters, view preferences, and session filter presets persist across page reloads via localStorage and sessionStorage.
The IntelWatchStrip shows live freshness indicators across the 50-country corpus on both Programs and Pitch pages.

discovery.first_action: Browse 50 programs with filters, search presets, or Gold Standard spotlight
discovery.research: Click a program card → ProgramModal with 7+ tabs of deep research

registration.step2: Enter display name + select target program from dropdown (grouped by region)
registration.step3: Review and confirm → creates UserProfile with status 'registered'

document_prep.workflow: Upload file → local SHA-256 hash → POST to Satohash API → poll until confirmed → proof on Bitcoin
document_prep.shared_registry: Documents are stored in a unified registry (localStorage) shared across Vault, Profile, and Dashboard
document_prep.export_import: Registry can be exported as JSON backup and restored from backup

application.fields: Name, target program (free text), notes, attached stamped documents
application.hashing: Payload is SHA-256 hashed (program + timestamp + npub + doc hashes)
application.post_submit: Redirect to /agents with application params for agent handoff
application.launch_gates: 5 gates must pass before applications open: Seal, Forge, Nexus, Ledger, Ops

agent_assignment.agent: Kimi (MotoPass AI agent) handles application processing
agent_assignment.office_hours: Agent availability follows Kimi's office hours schedule

program_matching.sovereignty_score: 0-100 scale measuring program independence, freedom scope, dual citizenship support, live/work rights
program_matching.crypto_friendly_score: 0-10 scale rating Bitcoin/crypto adoption in the jurisdiction
program_matching.stacking_synergy: low/medium/high rating of how well a program stacks with others
program_matching.risk_level: low/medium/high assessment of program stability and reliability
program_matching.flagship_depth: Boolean — true for programs with deep research templates (pathways, compliance clock, critical tests)
program_matching.proof_status: none/pending/confirmed — whether the program data has a Bitcoin proof via Satohash
program_matching.freshness: fresh (≤14d) / watch (≤45d) / stale (>45d) based on last_checked date

filter_presets.lightning: Lightning-ready only — programs with active Lightning Network merchant data
filter_presets.bitcoinFriendly: Crypto score ≥7 — jurisdictions with strong Bitcoin/crypto adoption

honesty_rules: Never claim a program is 'approved' or 'in progress' unless the user has actually submitted an application.
Registration creates a local profile — it does not submit anything to any government or authority.
Applications start as 'interest' status — they are not official submissions to program authorities.
The 5 launch gates determine when applications open — if gates haven't passed, applications are gated.
Program data freshness varies — always show the honest freshness badge (fresh/watch/stale).
Sovereignty scores and crypto scores are research-based estimates, not legal certifications.
Filter presets are shortcuts, not recommendations — they narrow the view, not advise on best programs.
Agent assignment (Kimi) is automated — the agent follows office hours and may not respond instantly.

member_scripts.how_to_start: Start at motopass.giveabit.io — the pitch page shows live stats and a 4-step guide: explore programs, stamp documents, build your portfolio, then apply.
member_scripts.how_to_register: Click Register, connect your Nostr wallet (you'll need a browser extension like nos2x or Alby), enter your name, pick a target program from the dropdown, and confirm.
member_scripts.how_to_apply: Visit /apply, fill in your name and target program, optionally attach stamped documents from the Vault, and submit. Your application is hashed and you'll be guided to meet Kimi, our AI agent.
member_scripts.how_to_find_program: Go to /programs — use the search bar for country names, the region sidebar to filter by geography, or the filter presets (Under $100K, Lightning-ready, Bitcoin-friendly) to narrow down options.
member_scripts.what_is_gold_standard: Uruguay and Bolivia are our Gold Standard flagships — they have the deepest research templates with full pathway analysis, compliance clocks, and critical test results that other programs reference.
member_scripts.how_to_compare: Click any program card, then click 'Open Compare' in the modal. You can compare up to 4 programs side-by-side with a matrix view showing investment, timelines, sovereignty, and Bitcoin readiness.
member_scripts.what_are_launch_gates: Launch gates are 5 checkpoints (Seal, Forge, Nexus, Ledger, Ops) that must all pass before applications open. They ensure the platform has Bitcoin proofs, a working marketplace, live relay, agent readiness, and CI validation.
member_scripts.what_is_portfolio: Your portfolio at /portfolio is a saved list of programs you're interested in. It shows combined statistics, a Compliance Clock for timelines, and syncs across pages. Add programs from the Programs page.
